plan.selection: 800-step development: reactive, recurrent, hidden fly and hidden GRU reached 100% short validation; blind failed all nonempty outputs. Use fixed 1200 steps and seeds 0,1,2 in confirmation. Select checkpoint by short validation exact then recent training loss.
plan.training_difference: Reactive/blind sample action-balanced single observations. Recurrent/hidden sample full expert trajectories. Architecture and training sampling both differ across these families. Conditions within a family use the same data and sampler.
plan.planning: 64 independent start-goal puzzles, 4 preselected seed-0 controllers; BFS is engineered and uses learned transition execution; witness program not passed to solver.
